_meta.purpose: Crime typology playbooks for synthetic case generation and training simulator drills. Stage sequences follow publicly documented Indian cyber-fraud patterns (I4C 'Digital Arrest' advisory, Mar 2025; NITI Aayog 'Digital Arrest: The Modern-Day Cyber Scam', Apr 2025; NCRP-reported investment/task-fraud and mule syndicates). Templates are Hinglish with {placeholders} filled from pools.json. DPDP 2023 compliant synthetic data.
_meta.ground_truth_contract: Every generated case ships with: entity values, money-flow edges, planted hidden links (pairs that never co-occur in one event), planted contradictions, statutory defects, and the typology label.

DIGITAL_ARREST.name: Digital Arrest Extortion
DIGITAL_ARREST.description: Fake law-enforcement 'digital arrest' extortion (I4C advisory pattern): spoof official contact, isolation via video call, coerced 'verification' transfer to a 'clearance' account, disposal.
chat_templates: ye {dept} ka notice aya hai aapke {case_ref} case mein, turant video call par aao
verification ke bina arrest ho jayega, darwaza band karke baitho
compliance ke liye {amount} {upi} par bhejo, 10 min mein
OTP {otp} aa raha hai, bol do turant
kaam ho gaya, number block kar do

INVESTMENT_TASK.name: Investment & Task App Fraud
INVESTMENT_TASK.description: Trading/task-app fraud (NCRP-reported dominant category): small guaranteed payouts first, then larger 'VIP' deposits, then withdrawal blocked with 'tax' demands.
chat_templates: sir aaj ka task complete karo, {amount} instant profit milega
VIP level 3 kholne ke liye {amount} deposit karo {upi} par
withdrawal pending hai, 30% tax pehle bhejo
id block ho gaya hai, agent se baat karo
aapka account permanently closed hai

MULE_OFFRAMP.description: Systematic recruitment of commercial and student mule bank accounts, high-velocity pass-through transfers, and cashout via ATM/crypto off-ramps.
